scientific_integrity: All finite face families were exhaustively enumerated; signed integral boundary matrices were reduced by unimodular unit pivots and checked with an independent Smith-normal-form routine.
scientific_limitations: Exact reduced integral homology only for circular ladders with 3<=n<=8; no higher-order, homotopy-type or independently audited claim. Novelty cannot exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: First third homology in circular-ladder general-position complexes
